notes.title: Mutations & Superpowers Nanoupdate
notes.content:
Mutations now have proper names
Some mutations now have extra Antihex effects
Starting superpowers are all highest power (not only the middle)

notes.title: Clarity, Eye Comfort, Wisps Update [#8]
notes.content:
Clarity & Eye Comfort
The background was greatly muted, you can intensify it back in the Video settings now

Enemy and ally visuals were greatly boosted to stand out

All enemies now have a rose-red bloody boundary

All allies now have a green boundary

Enemy spawn visuals greatly softened not to be too distracting

Attack visuals (Wisps, Blasts and Rifts) slightly muted not to overpower foreground

Wisp and Hex VFX altered to blend better

New on Damaged VFX to clearly indicate when the player gets damaged!

Some background colors altered to be less distracting
[p align="start"]Store graphics have already been updated this time!
Gameplay Changes
Enemies now always spawn with a Control Resistance Color

Wisps now wander around randomly

Wisps are now stronger pulled by Rifts

Wisps no longer hit enemies instantly in range like lightning, but instead quickly fly towards them like missiles

notes.title: New Frosty Mechanic: Antihex, Variety, QoL, Graphics (again), VFX Update [#7]
notes.content:
Main Changes
Antihex: a new crystalline debuff applied by Blasts and Rifts that slows down enemies and is shattered on Wall Hits because some players felt like the game became way too fast due to Hex being the only debuff

Superpowers remixed to add a lot of options related to Antihex, some for conversion between Hex and Antihex, most to make Hex superpowers also apply to Antihex

Hex greatly buffed to account for its opposite existing

Enemy spawning VFX!!! are finally here, helping you see clearly where the enemies are going to appear

Graphics upgrades to help with the 3D feeling and clarity, including enemy glow, etc, WITHOUT making performance worse

Contrast clarity improved, the background muted, important objects are more visible 

Color changes from superpowers to indicate their effects better
[p align="start"]Store graphics will be updated accordingly... as usual... there graphics updates might become a pattern...

notes.title: Biomes, Variety, Mechanics, Font, Graphics Update [#6]
notes.content:
Main Changes
2 extra biomes: in addition to the normal biome, 2 new wild biomes now can be unlocked as you progress in the game:
[olist]
A default biome

An energetic biome with accelerated enemy spawns, push-pull (on enemies) and pulsating dish size

A decaying biome with more spirit enemies, slowed down enemy spawns, pull (on enemies) and slowly shrinking dish size
[/olist]
3 new superpowers related to Pebbles

Ward, Dash and Regen mechanics rebalanced with many tweaks and interdependencies (more in the Info menu)

Spirit Enemies now deal less damage, cut down Energy and can be slightly damaged

Wisp Hits and Hex now have more chaotic movement effects

Upgraded graphics towards physics-based 3D with volumetric shadowing and water distortions

Upgraded the font engine to handle kerning and advance, introduced a beautiful font that fits the game better

Visual tweaks

Store graphics will be updated accordingly


Upcoming
New Antihex slowdown-shatter-type (eldritch ice) debuff on enemies to enable more interactions with Blasts, Rifts and Wall Hits.

notes.title: Co-op Bugfixes
notes.content:
No more infinite co-op superpower crashy exploit


Co-op states properly reset on connection break/interruption


Co-op host&client superpower rarities are properly separated


The terrifying sound of low health now properly updates on the client instead of growling into your ears 24/7, no more ASMR

notes.title: Swarm Sim Secret Bonus Nanoupdate
notes.content:
Watch Swarms - bonus simulation-toy mode, this was a secret devtool, now no longer secret
Eye graphics fixes

notes.title: Starting Infotips, Superpower Infotips QoL Nanoupdate
notes.content:
Skippable starting screen with Basics for new players
Toggleable Infotips during Superpower selection to reduce the journeys to the Info menu

You can hide the Infotips in Settings!

notes.title: Knockable Pebble Disks, Variety, Graphics Update [#5] + Full Release in 12h
notes.content:
Main Changes
Added Pebbles: physical disks that can be knocked into enemies for similar effects as wall hits, bounce off walls and can be used as shields

New enemy subtype: Spirit - can't be damaged, but dies on its own

3 new superpowers related to Pebbles

New mutation group: Rift Armor, this time very risky health-draining mutations to challenge you!

Replaced placeholder toon graphics with more PBR but still stylized graphics store graphics will be updated ASAP

Rebalanced enemy speeds to be more manageable

Fixed animations

Fixed the client in high-ping online co-op being flung around when using mouse-only movement control
Full Release
The core mechanics are all implemented, the online co-op works so far as the numerous tests go, full release is ready. The following updates will focus on content, variety, QoL and bugfixes. While the price might increase at some point after a lot of new content is added, it won't increase at the moment of full release in 12 hours.

notes.title: Online Co-op now available! Multiplayer Update [#4] + Upcoming Full Release
notes.content:
Duo online co-op now available
One player hosts the game, another joins through the Steam Friend List

Steam Datagram Relay is used, there is no need to forward ports, host and client IP addresses are hidden

The host can autosave the game progress on every completed level

There is currently only one save for solo runs and only one save for co-op runs (belonging to the host, any client can join any co-op save)

The host and the client have their own superpowers, some superpowers have global effects

The host and the client have their own mutations, in case of different mutations the effect is chosen based on which player is closer to the event
Requirements for Host
300KB/s upload speed, 100KB/s download speed, minimum 1280MTU, <20% UDP packet loss, minimum 200/200 packets per second up/down
Requirements for Client
100KB/s upload speed, 300KB/s download speed, minimum 1280MTU, <20% UDP packet loss, minimum 200/200 packets per second up/down


Additional changes
Simulation and netcode tickrate increased to 200hz

Greatly reduced input latencies

Netcode extrapolation in case of dropped UDP packets

Rebalanced kinetics and speeds of entities

A lot of QoL related to Steam overlay and Rich Presence
Upcoming Full Release Update Plan
As the core features are almost fully polished now, the Full Release will happen after Update #5 somewhere next week. Afterwards the updates will be content updates (new biomes, environmental interactions), variety updates (more behaviors, superpowers, etc.) and QoL updates

notes.title: UI, QoL, Font, Collision, Hex, Audio Update [#3] + Online Co-op WIP Announcement
notes.content:
Readability Changes:

Info menu reworked to be easy to read
Mutation selection menu reworked to be easier to use
Font VFX removed to make text more readable, now can be turned on in Video options
Energy Bar will shrink when Dash is not ready


Audio Changes:

Game will no longer crash without system Audio output enabled
Game will restore Audio if Audio output is lost
Enemy Loop SFX adjusted to be more disturbing and overtly noticeable
Reduced directional audio panning
Increased doppler effect for looped sounds
Higher framerate Audio interpolation


Game Changes:

High-speed collision tunneling is gone, now you can Body Hit enemies with a perfect Dash, and the Enemy Pinballing is scarier
Hex causes chaotic Frenzied Movement, be careful!
Lifesteal is now gradual, not instant to prevent AFK
Lifesteal now has a maximum to prevent AFK
Enemy Wall Bounce now aims at the player slightly, not just the screen centre


EXPERIMENTAL! In the following days/weeks you might become able to participate in testing multiplayer on the beta branch! The updates on that branch will happen silently. Once the multiplayer is working, an announcement will happen and it will be uploaded to the main branch

notes.title: Controller Support, QoL, Readability Update [#1]
notes.content:
Starting from now you can play the game in any of the following configurations:

Mouse only (as recommended)
Keyboard only
Controller only
Any combination of 1 mouse, 1 keyboard and 16 controllers

All menus can be navigated with any combination of these now. The game will automatically pause if you disconnect or connect controllers. The switching between devices is implemented to not require any settings adjustments and happens automatically.

The SteamInput API has very simple controls for controllers:

DPad movement and menu navigation
Left analog stick movement and menu navigation
3 buttons (Cross|A/Circle|B/Options|Start) dash/back/pause ingame and select/back/unpause in menu


Additional changes:

Text VFX scaling fixed to be readable in small windows
Improved readability of button and card states
Adjusted several superpower descriptions (related to "weaken" being unclear)
Expanded the info menu with clearer descriptions and also tips
Added early game maximum level ramp (3, 6, 9, 10, 10, 10... instead of always 10, 10, 10...) to enable early accessible mutations
Fixed achievements not showing up without game restart
Preparations for Steam Deck support
